svg.aria-label: I'm a Systems Engineer from Honduras who builds production software across the full stack: web apps with React and Next.js, iOS and Android apps with React Native (Expo), and the APIs, databases and infrastructure behind them. AI is the multiplier; engineering judgment is the base. Off the clock: Morning runs, Harry Potter, Indie rock, The Strokes · Tame Impala · Arctic Monkeys.
